MYO Quest — anatomical assets

Source: Z-Anatomy / Models-of-human-anatomy
https://github.com/Z-Anatomy/Models-of-human-anatomy
Source archive: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Z-Anatomy/Models-of-human-anatomy/master/Z-Anatomy.zip
File: Z-Anatomy/Startup.blend (archive version dated 2023-05-02)
Authors: Gauthier Kervyn, Marcin Zielinski and contributors.
Underlying BodyParts3D models: Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS).
License of Z-Anatomy adaptation and these derived GLB files: CC BY-SA 4.0.
Full source license and required BodyParts3D credits: Z-Anatomy-LICENSE.txt.

Adaptation by MYO Quest, 2026-10-21:
- Read original mesh data without executing embedded Blender scripts.
- Select 744 physical structures; exclude annotation meshes and cavity-volume helpers.
- Preserve source base vertices, use saved world matrices, convert Z-up to glTF Y-up.
- Triangulate polygons and recompute smooth vertex normals; no geometry decimation.
- Separate muscles / skeletal support bundles, attach stable semantic ids and French labels.
- Apply neutral anatomical display materials at runtime.
- Source modifiers are not evaluated. Subdivision is not applied; fine ethmoidal cavities
  produced by source booleans are not represented by the exported base mesh.
- Some muscle groups (interossei, lumbricals) remain grouped as in the source.
- Tendinous portions included within source muscle meshes are not separately segmented.

Source SHA-256 and geometry counts are recorded in atlas.json.
No clinical certification or specialist validation is implied.
